scope: Third narrow exact-arithmetic slice: restrict only8 full-width Coriolis propagation GEMMs to exact parent/current prefixes. No solver, controller, timestep, model or physical-gate changes.

change.method: Keep full parent copies, root fills, own-joint blocks and all weighted scratch. Parent-stage5 propagation GEMMs use the parent assembly prefix; COM-stage3 use the current-link prefix. Shared per-stage guards require actual derived coefficient matrices finite, omitted RHS tails exactly zero and omitted output tails bitwise+0. Otherwise original full-width arithmetic is used. Static row/inner dimensions, GEMM order and beta=1 remain unchanged. Helper also falls back for alpha outside±1.

preSimulationArithmeticProof.comparison: Bitwise matrices, both LU factors/pivots, all Cv/Cw fields and weighted scratch against both original dense reference and published bound-prefix baseline.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.fixtures: Branched25-body synthetic model with massless coordinate frames, massive descendants, free/fixed root, kinematic link, rotated/moving/repeated states and passive diagonals.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.invalidCases: NaN/Inf and huge finite retained values, RHS signed-zero/nonzero/invalid tails, output signed-zero/nonzero/invalid tails, finite source vectors producing coefficient overflow, empty/full domains, alpha±1 and conservative alpha2 fallback.

independentReferenceCorrection.finding: The initial reference shared coefficient hoisting with the candidate. Restoring literal original expressions exposed a NaN-sign bit difference in rejected stages. Rejected stages now execute the literal original sequence, and all bitwise checks pass against that independent source reference.

nativeWorkspaceParity.comparison: Exact full JSON equality, no float tolerances
nativeWorkspaceParity.standingGate: All unchanged predicates at every 800 Hz sample from 0.5 s; no failures. Full cumulative loaded slip remains <=20 mm.

limits: Candidate rejected. Functional chain not run; production remains the published sticky-bound scalar engine.
Native/backend performance and standing/recovery release qualification remain distinct.
No historical failing tests are ignored or claimed fixed.

rejectionReason: Exact arithmetic/native/browser state parity passes, but matched actual browser forward/reverse pairs show no material gain and a pooled1.2%wall-time regression. Production changes rejected.
